title: AuthenticationAssurance
description: Descriptive information about how a principal authenticated for the current context -- not a business authorization grant (ADR-0015 §180). Consumers use this to decide whether a risk-sensitive operation's AssuranceRequirement (assurance-requirement.schema.json) is met, not to authorize the operation itself.

acr.description: OIDC Authentication Context Class Reference for this authentication event, as asserted by the issuer.

amr.description: OIDC Authentication Methods References used to establish this authentication (e.g. pwd, webauthn, otp).

authenticated_at.description: When the underlying authentication event occurred (OIDC auth_time).

step_up_at.description: When a step-up re-authentication most recently occurred, if any (ADR-0015 §37-39).

issuer.description: The verified OIDC issuer that authenticated this principal.

client_id.description: The OAuth client (azp) the authentication was performed for.
